features.name: Multiplier pairs

features.name: Three bonus games
features.description: Triggered by FS pairs, starting with Guilty As Gin.

review:
No paylines – every symbol arrives as a left or right half, and you win by matching a pair across connected reels 1–2, 3–4 or 5–6. It takes a few spins to read, then it clicks.

Multiplier pairs work the same way, with an 'x' on one half and a number on the other, and a completed pair boosts every win on the spin, up to 20x. A single FS pair is enough to trigger the Guilty As Gin free spins, with three bonus tiers up to the 12,500x max. Fresh and different.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
